turns.assessment: The simultaneous failure of every unprotected service whose ODU working path crosses S10, together with protection switching for protected services, matches a common OTN switching-layer failure. O13 directly reports OTN_FABRIC_FAIL at otn.S10 at the same time. Unchanged optical power, OSNR, BER, amplifier telemetry, and line-interface telemetry on S10–S19 strongly exclude an OMS, amplifier, fibre, ROADM, or coherent-line fault.

proposals.rationale: The S10 OTN switch raised an explicit fabric-failure alarm coincident with the outage. The broad ODU impact and SNCP behavior are characteristic of interruption of ODUs cross-connected through the switch, while the optical layer remained stable.
